description: Smart Pedestrian Project is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. Smart Cities, Smart Liverpool, Smart Pedestrian Project Thousands of people walk through the Liverpool city centre every day and, through the Smart Pedestrian Project, the paths they take will help shape the city’s future. Liverpool City Council is counting pedestrian and vehicle movements around the city centre, collecting data from smart devices and camera-counting technology. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are Civic, Liverpool, Liverpool City Council, University, air. It offers 6 resource(s) in data, json, pdf. The portal shows 2023-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
